title: Canonical free-parameter evaluation data
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring and $X$ a scheme, in the compatible universes and ordinary unbounded internal-module derived categories of [def-weil-size-convention], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Use the point pullback of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback], its canonical tensor and composition maps of [lem-sfb-point-pullback-derived-hom], the free parameter $A_P=R[h_P]$ of [def-sfb-condensed-free-module-generators] and test scheme $U_P=X[P]$ of [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]. Define $F(N)=p_X^*R\mathcal Hom_R(A_P,N)$ using the closed derived Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom] [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The universal generator over $U_P$ is the pullback of $[\mathrm{id}_P]$ along the tautological graph. Its restrictions along all arrows to the terminal test are compatible, and the regular-module/global-section adjunction gives an actual map $1\to p_{U_P}^*A_P$. Define the derived evaluation by inserting this generator and applying pulled-back closed evaluation. Define $c:F(N)\to R\rho_{P*}p_{U_P}^*N$ to be its adjunct under [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], with the canonical point-composition identification. Define $\beta$ to be the transpose of pulled-back closed derived evaluation, identifying $p_X^*A_P[0]$ with the actual derived free object of [lem-sfb-profinite-free-slice-derived-hom]. All compositions restrict to the localized sites of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] is not used to define $c$ or $\beta$.
